## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new functionality
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: restructuring without behavior change
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore`: configuration, dependencies, CI
- [ ] `test`: tests

## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green and the security scan reports no new findings
- [ ] I added tests, including hostile input where it applies
- [ ] I updated `docs/api.md` if requests, results or errors changed
- [ ] I added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, or the change does not alter behavior
- [ ] No network access, telemetry or logging of user content was added
- [ ] I am not adding secrets, certificates, signing identities or personal data
- [ ] Code, comments and docs are in English and follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
